mainEntity.name: Can I manage Website AI Discovery Files myself?

acceptedAnswer.text: While it's technically possible for an in-house team with specialized expertise in AI, data structuring, and SEO to manage Website AI Discovery Files, it's often complex and resource-intensive. It requires continuous monitoring of AI algorithm updates, ongoing content analysis, and technical implementation. Many businesses find it more efficient to partner with a specialized provider who has the dedicated tools, expertise, and resources to ensure optimal performance and keep up with the rapidly evolving AI landscape, allowing them to focus on core business operations.
acceptedAnswer.description: Managing AI Discovery Files yourself is possible but complex, requiring specialized expertise and continuous monitoring of AI updates. Many businesses prefer specialized providers.
